Bromopride (rINN) Bromoprida; Bromopridum; CM-8252; VAL-13081. 4-Amino-5- bromo-N-(2-diethylaminoethyl)-o-anisamide. Бромоприд C14H22BrN3O2 = 344.2. CAS — 4093-35-0. ATC — A03FA04. ATC Vet — QA03FA04. Profile Bromopride is a substituted benzamide similar to metoclopra- mide (p.1747), used in a variety of gastrointestinal disorders in- cluding nausea and vomiting (p.1700) and motility disorders. It is given in a usual oral dose of 20 to 60 mg daily in divided doses, or 20 mg daily by intramuscular or intravenous injection. The hydrochloride is also used.
